scoring_justification: Checker compares agent's computed values (dipole, rotational constants, harmonic wavenumbers/intensities) and geometric planarity to paper-reported MP2/6-311G(3df,2p) values from Tables 1 and 2, using generous tolerances appropriate for code-dependent variations.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold values for dipole moment, rotational constants, and harmonic vibrational data
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from the paper's reported values
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's own published numbers; the reference solution uses them, and a correct reproduction should match closely enough given the tolerances.

schema.description: Standard XYZ file with 6 atoms, coordinates in Angstroms.

outputs.description: XYZ coordinates of the optimized formamide geometry.
Dipole moment and rotational constants (A, B, C) computed from the MP2 wavefunction; compared to reference values within tolerances.
Unscaled harmonic wavenumbers and absolute IR intensities for all 12 normal modes; compared to reference values with mode-dependent tolerances.

output_contract.notes: The geometry is evaluated silently; the other parameters are scored with tolerances hidden in the checker. All reference values are the paper's reported MP2/6-311G(3df,2p) results.
